Title: Retirement: Add-ons Feature in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
The public preview add-ons feature in Azure Container Apps will be retired on September 30, 2025. To prepare for this change, transition to Azure managed services, such as Azure Cache for Redis or Azure Database for PostgreSQL, if you’re ready to use a production level service. Alternatively, you can try one of our new open source quick starts to continue using these services for dev/test purposes.  


To avoid service disruptions, please follow these instructions to move to our open source quickstarts or an Azure managed service by September 30, 2025.
